input_messages.content: Hi there! I’m having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone. It’s been happening for the past few hours, and I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me figure out what’s going on?
Sure! My name is John Smith, and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know what you need me to do next.

I checked, and it looks like my messaging app cannot send MMS messages right now. My mobile data is turned on, and I’m connected to the cellular network, but the signal is pretty weak and it’s only showing 2G. Regular text messages (SMS) are working fine, and I can use mobile data for other apps, but MMS just won’t go through.

What should I try next?

I switched my phone’s network mode to “4G/5G preferred,” and now I’m seeing a strong 5G signal in the status bar. However, I still can’t send MMS messages—my messaging app says it’s unable to send them.

What should I try next?

I checked my APN settings, and the APN name is set to "internet." The MMSC URL is "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc." 

Is there anything else I should look for, or do these settings seem correct?

I went ahead and reset my APN settings to the default values and rebooted my phone as you suggested. Unfortunately, I’m still unable to send MMS messages—my messaging app still says it can’t send them.

Is there anything else we can try? I’m starting to get a bit frustrated since nothing seems to be working so far.

Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned off on my device, so that shouldn’t be interfering. I checked my messaging app’s permissions, and it only has permission for “phone”—it doesn’t have access to storage or SMS.

Should I enable those permissions for the messaging app? If so, could you guide me through it?

I’ve enabled both “storage” and “SMS” permissions for my messaging app. I just checked, and now I’m able to send MMS messages again!

Thank you so much for your help—looks like that solved the problem.
Thank you! I really appreciate your help and patience walking me through everything. Have a wonderful day!
Thanks again! I’ll reach out if I run into any more issues. Take care! ###STOP###
